title: I made a 30 s teaser for my AI-built incremental game, without recording a single frame by hand
author: Noah__1302
selftext:
Spaghettify is a black hole incremental (dust to universe), built with Claude Code and Godot. The teaser has no voiceover and no art assets. Every planet, star and the hole itself is a procedural shader, and the music is synthesized in Python.

The part I liked most: the footage comes from the game itself. A script starts the game with a fixed seed, an autopilot bot plays, and Movie Maker records it. Claude also wrote the edit table and the music script. I only decided what the teaser should feel like (no gameplay dump, no boss spoilers, silence before the title).

Question for you: do you make trailers with AI tooling too, or do you capture by hand? I’m unsure whether the silent-then-title ending works.
